goal: Execution context outranks a registered planning identity without silencing its current work
invariants: Current claimed execution can report phases and evidence before and after planning handoff
Execution context cannot borrow planning, release, proposal, readiness or human-decision authority
Anonymous execution attribution cannot become an interactive user
Stale, partial and terminal run identities refuse
Logical planning context retains its actual jurisdiction
Role names and imported registration do not define execution authority
